new_findings.title: Worker discards unsuccessful sweep reports
new_findings.defect: apps/prototype-description-service/recognition/worker/scan_worker.py:445-451 - `await UsageSettlementService(session).sweep_stale_reservations(...)` is followed by `await session.commit()` with no result assignment. The service records `report.stalled = True` and `report.exit_code = 1` at recognition/application/services/usage_settlement_service.py:745-747, but the scheduled caller drops that failure status instead of logging it.
new_findings.failure_scenario: A stale RESERVED row with unknown job evidence or a stale fence produces a nonzero stalled report; the worker commits, emits no warning, and retries only at the next interval while the reservation continues consuming tenant allowance without an operator signal.
new_findings.fix: Capture the returned report and log or publish a metric when exit_code is nonzero or rejected, fail_closed, or missing counts are nonzero; add a schedule test returning a stalled report and asserting the alert signal.

summary: Both recorded sweeper corrections hold: the CLI now settles through evidence-based fenced recovery and the scan worker schedules bounded sweeps. A new medium finding is that the worker drops non-success SweepReport values. The lane unit suite could not complete because aiosqlite timed out in the sandbox, and the PostgreSQL identity-schema integration guard was not run because no database is available.
